content: Adam popoŋana kini
Iŋgi Adam popoŋana kini tipet ta kembei: Indeeŋe Anutu iur zin tomtom na, iur zin kembei ta itunu ruŋguunu.
Iur tomooto mi moori. Iur zin makiŋ, to ipombol zin mi ipaata zin be ‘tomtom.’
Adam ndaama kini irao kembei 130, to ipeebe pikin tomooto ta ma kembei ta itunu ruŋguunu, mi ipaata zaana be Set.
Set isu, to Adam imbot pa ndaama 800 tomen, mi ipeebe pikin tomooto mi moori pakan.
Ndaama ki Adam irao 930, mana imeete.
Set ndaama kini irao 105, to ipeebe pikin tomooto ta, zaana Enos.
Enos isu, to Set imbot pa ndaama 807 tomen, mi ipeebe pikin tomooto mi moori pakan.
Ndaama ki Set irao 912, mana imeete.
Enos ndaama kini irao 90, to ipeebe pikin tomooto ta, zaana Kenan.
Kenan isu, to Enos imbot pa ndaama 815 tomen, mi ipeebe pikin tomooto mi moori pakan.
Ndaama ki Enos irao 905, mana imeete.
Kenan ndaama kini irao 70, to ipeebe pikin tomooto ta, zaana Malalel.
Malalel isu, to Kenan imbot pa ndaama 840 tomen, mi ipeebe pikin tomooto mi moori pakan.
Ndaama ki Kenan irao 910, mana imeete.
Malalel ndaama kini irao 65, to ipeebe pikin tomooto ta, zaana Yared.
Yared isu, to Malalel imbot pa ndaama 830 tomen, mi ipeebe pikin tomooto mi moori pakan.
Ndaama ki Malalel irao 895, mana imeete.
Yared ndaama kini irao 162, to ipeebe pikin tomooto ta, zaana Enok.
Enok isu, to Yared imbot pa ndaama 800 tomen, mi ipeebe pikin tomooto mi moori pakan.
Ndaama ki Yared irao 962, mana imeete.
Enok ndaama kini irao 65, to ipeebe pikin tomooto ta, zaana Metusela.
Metusela isu, to Enok ziru Anutu tiwwa ma irao ndaama 300. Mi Enok ipeebe pikin tomooto mi moori pakan.

content.text: Tana Enok ziru Anutu tiwwa mi ndaama ki Enok irao 365, tona Enok imbiriizi ma tire i mini som. Paso, Anutu ikami ma ila kini kek.

content: Metusela ndaama kini irao 187, to ipeebe pikin tomooto ta, zaana Lamek.
Lamek isu, to Metusela imbot pa ndaama 782 tomen, mi ipeebe pikin tomooto mi moori pakan.
Ndaama ki Metusela irao 969, mana imeete.
Lamek ndaama kini irao 182, to ipeebe pikin tomooto ta
mi iso: “Anutu ipasaana toono kek, tanata ikam ma takamam uraata biibi kat. Tamen tori ti ko iuulu iti ma ketende su pa uraata kiti.” Tana Lamek ipaata pikin zaana be Noa.
Noa isu, to Lamek imbot pa ndaama 595 tomen, mi ipeebe pikin tomooto mi moori pakan.
Ndaama ki Lamek irao 777, mana imeete.
Noa ndaama kini irao 500, tona ipeebe pikin tomooto tel, ta zan Sem, Ham mi Yapet.

footnotes.text: Zin Israel tipaata sua ‘tomtom’ ila zitun kalŋan be ‘Adam.’
